description: Run one DuckDB read expression against staged drought tables, optionally ending with one semicolon. Get canvas_id from drought_get_timeseries or drought_compare_areas and inspect columns with drought_dataframe_describe. For every original row, SELECT * FROM the table ORDER BY row_id and follow next_offset until null. Arbitrary SQL pagination requires your own stable ORDER BY. Exact totals require SELECT COUNT(*).

canvas_id.description: Token returned by a drought producer.

limit.description: Maximum returned rows, clamped to 500 with disclosure and further bounded by complete response size.

offset.description: Rows to skip in the stable ordered query.

sql.description: One DuckDB read expression with an optional terminal semicolon; staged tables only.

name: drought_dataframe_query

countIsExact.description: True only when the page exhausts the query at offset zero.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective page ceiling after clamping to 500.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: Analytical provider is disabled or unavailable. `canvas_not_found`: Token is absent, expired or belongs to another tenant. `missing_table`: A named staged table is absent. `invalid_sql`: SQL cannot parse or bind. `sql_execution_error`: A data conversion or range expression fails. `sql_read_only`: SQL gate rejects a write, external read or system catalog. `dataset_too_large`: Combined source metadata exceeds the query response budget. `query_row_too_large`: One projected row cannot fit a complete response. `staging_busy`: Two queries are already active in this process. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitNotice.description: Disclosure when the requested limit was clamped.

next_offset.description: Continue with this offset and identical SQL, or null.

rows.description: Complete projected values on this page.

shown.description: Complete rows shown on the truncated page.

tableMetadata.description: Bounded table identity and source provenance.

items.description: One staged source table and its retained attribution.

provenance.description: Source attribution; full metadata is available from describe.

truncated.description: More query rows remain beyond this page.

title: Query staged drought data
